prompts.name: hero
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Original artwork for a children's kitten typing game, ages 9-12. Restrained contemporary Instagram boutique stationery style, fluffy cute kittens with natural faces, polished soft 3D storybook rendering, soft daylight, warm white and very pale blush and lilac. Not babyish, no ornate royal decorations, no gold trim, no logos, no watermark, no written labels. Create one isolated fluffy WHITE kitten with lilac-grey eyes, small pink nose, sitting and looking gently toward viewer, one paw resting beside two large cream keyboard keycaps showing clearly F and J. A small plain pale lilac cushion below kitten. All paws and ears and tail fully visible, subtle grounding shadow. True transparent background. Clean silhouette with plenty of margin. No other text, no jewelry, no bows, no scenery. Square composition.
